warning[ZBX-W0205]: older output of the container was dropped
  cause  the log keeps at most 5 MiB; 40 bytes of older output were dropped
  fix    see the newest output only, without this note:   zbx logs --tail 100 <name>
  more   zbx explain W0205 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
